notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3 has been released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

BUSTED! has been updated to version [b]1.0.1.3[/b]. This is a minor update which fixes a couple of bugs.

[i]1.0.1.3 - Update Notes
+ Added version number to the title screen.
- Fixed the super bar's "Active" status sometimes disappearing before the end of the effect.
- Fixed being able to access locked features from the "Continue" screen.[/i]

- Silver Cow Studio
